title: Re-wiring of Lighthouse tower, Power house, Staff Quarters, Inspection Quarter, Supply and installation of Street lights poles and ESE Lightning Arrester at Bhatkal Lighthouse under Goa Directorate.
summary: Complete electrical rewiring of the lighthouse tower, power house, staff quarters and inspection quarter at Bhatkal Lighthouse (Karnataka, Goa Directorate), with new LT panels, street light poles, a submersible pump set and an ESE lightning arrester with copper plate earthing.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Bhatkal Lighthouse
sites.work: Rewiring of LH tower, power house, NA-1/NA-2/LHA staff quarters, inspection quarter and office; LT panels; street lights; submersible pump; ESE lightning arrester and earthing

money.performance_security: 3% of contract value as Bank Guarantee/FDR within 15 days of Letter of Intent, valid 3 months after expiry of the 2 year warranty/guarantee period
money.notes: Estimated cost including all taxes. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa, by 21/09/2022 16:00, valid 90 days from publishing of tender; technical evaluation also refers to 'EMD/Bid Securing Declaration (form 9.7)'. Tender fee Rs 500 non-refundable DD. Rates quoted in the BoQ xls only; GST paid extra as per actual; no advance payment; payment after satisfactory execution; quantities approximate, paid on measurement.

period.completion: 90 days from the date of award of contract (Section 6.9: lightning protection system within 60 days from commencement)
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of bid
period.warranty: 2 years from completion/acceptance for all work; ESE lightning protection system guaranteed 2 years (24 months) from acceptance

eligibility: At least one similar work >= Rs 16,49,449, or two >= Rs 10,30,906 each, or three >= Rs 8,24,724 each in last seven years for Central/State Govt, PSU or private firm; similar work = electrification works, ESE lightning arrester, electrical UG cable works
Minimum 3 years experience in similar work
Valid electrical contractor licence for all electrical works; company registration; PAN and GST

Financial standing: turnover, P&L and auditor's report for past three years; ITRs for AY 2019-20, 2020-21, 2021-22; bank solvency certificate from scheduled bank; check-up list asks average turnover of last 3 years not less than 50% of estimated cost

Lists of works in hand, similar works completed, technical and administrative staff with EPF details; litigation/blacklisting disclosure; make and model of proposed LED lights, cables, switches, MCBs/RCCBs, fans
Tender acceptance letter (9.4), undertaking (9.5), non-blacklist affidavit (9.6), bid security declaration (9.7), technical bid check-up list (9.8)
Technical evaluation scored out of 100 (statutory 25, financial 15, experience 40, declarations 15, makes 5); minimum 70% to open commercial bid; lowest-priced technically qualified bidder wins
specs: Light fittings Philips/Luker/Havells/Crompton; cables Polycab/Havells/Finolex; switches Legrand/Havells Fabio/GM/Anchor Roma

Concealed wiring except lighthouse tower; copper FRLS wiring; CPWD General Specifications for Electrical Works 2013 Part I (Internal) and Part VII (DG sets); Indian Electricity Act 2003 and Rules 1956; MESCOM meter and service connection norms
UG cable in trench 30-45 cm wide, 0.5 m deep with sand cushioning and brick/tile cover

ESE air terminal per NF C 17-102, installation per BS 6651:1999; SS304 shell; capture rod 20-25 mm; triggering distance 50-60 m; min 80 m radius protection at level III with tip 2 m above lantern house (BoQ item 6.014 says 60 m radius); CPRI 8/20 microsecond 40 kA impulse test; weight 4-6 kg
Lightning mast 6 m single length GI C class (spec says min 60 mm dia, BoQ says 40 mm dia) with 300x300x10 mm base plate, 6 mm SS304 stay wires, M20 concrete foundation, 40 mm GI triangle support

Down conductor 25x3 mm 99.9% electrolytic copper, PVC/heat-shrink insulated, on insulators every 2 ft, approx 40 m (17 m tower + 8 m mast and bend + 15 m earth run); IP67 flash counter 3-100 kA, 3 year battery; test point box

Copper plate earthing 600x600x3 mm with 25x3 mm strip at 10 ft depth, two pits min 10 ft apart in parallel, earth resistance below 1 ohm, IS 3043 / IS 2309, 450 mm inspection chamber with CI/FRP cover
LT panels 16 SWG CRCA powder coated Siemens grey; 25kA 4P SPD; 1.5 kW 30 stage single phase submersible pump
